organizer.name: Highwaymen Moto-biking Group
organizer.description:
Highwaymen Moto-biking group is a professional riding & ride organization group with over a decade of experience in planning & organizing rides.
We are proficient in organizing the rides as below:

HALF DAY RIDES – Motorbike rides which start as early as 6AM and end by 2PM the same day
ONE DAY RIDES - Motorbike rides which start as early as 6AM and end by 6 - 8PM the same day
MULTI DAY RIDES –Motorbike rides from a minimum of 2 days to a maximum of 14 days.
We have organized, ridden & marshalled rides. Some of our longest rides also known as MEGARIDES are as below:

Ride to Leh, Ladakh - 2017
Ride to Rann of Kutch - 2018
Ride to Bhutan - 2019
Ride to Rameswaram, Kanyakumari, Megamalai & Valparai - 2022
Ride to Rajasthan - 2023
Ride to North East - 2024 (Assam, Meghalaya & Arunachal Pradesh)
We explore the exhilarating experiences and freedom that comes with riding. From the open road to breathtaking landscapes, discover why motorbiking is a favorite among adventure seekers. So, if you are an adrenaline junkie with at least a 150cc or above bike and looking to explore the world on your bike, come, ride with us.

Why ride with Highwaymen?
1) Punctuality & Safety – With over a decade of experience in riding and organizing , we are proud to say, we always start our rides on time and encourage all our riders to be on time too. Safety is our topmost priority. We ensure all riders & pillions(if any) always wear full face helmets, riding jacket or jacket with elbow guards,
riding pants or jeans with knee guards, riding or sports shoes. If you don’t have it, you can rent from us.
2) Customized rides(trips) & tours – Based on your needs we plan the itinerary & the breaks. Ranging from a minimum of 30kms to a maximum of 100 kms we help by planning not just rides but also customize the rides to suit your needs
3) LSM formation riding – We always ride in Lead Sweep Moderator single formation riding. We ensure nobody overtakes the lead or falls behind the sweep, the group is managed by a Moderator or Marshall who moderates the speed and navigates the entire group thereby ensuring everyone rides together & no one misses a turning or over speeds while riding. The idea is also to ensure we don’t block traffic. The LSMs of  a group are identified by High Visibility Reflective Jackets
4) Backup Vehicle & Doctor  – We ensure we have a backup vehicle for all type of rides. This is done so that the luggage is placed in the car and the ride experience is enhanced. Puncture kit, first aid kit, tool kit, paddock stand and a mechanic complete the contents of the backup car. All rides also involve an experienced doctor who is part of the ride in case of an emergency
5) DMC communication – The ride organizing team have Bluetooth with DMC(Dynamic Mesh Communication) feature enabled. This feature helps up to 15 of us to communicate spanning over a km which helps in better coordination during the entire ride even with our helmets on.
6) Requirement – The only requirement is, the rider must possess a valid 2 wheeler Driving License, the rest-Motorbike & Riding Gear will be arranged by us if needed
